runtime_observation.note: Use only when the platform/OEM exposes a specific firmware version; otherwise bind the runtime to the snapshot key.
A baseband suffix is never promoted to a full version.

recommended_additive_field.purpose: Bind runtime evidence to the exact/partial software state without overloading firmware_version.

phase155.rule: CarrierConfig/Carrier Settings records should carry software_snapshot_key when exact device-observed configuration is collected.

recommended_additive_field.purpose: Tie IMS registration, VoLTE/VoNR/Wi-Fi Calling and call/SMS bearer evidence to the software/radio/carrier-settings state used in the test.

rules: Do not transfer IMS/VoLTE/VoNR success from one baseband/carrier-settings snapshot to another without new evidence.
A generic carrier operation-check result remains partial_snapshot unless the exact build/baseband/carrier-settings version is published.

recommended_additive_field.purpose: Tie registration/APN/session/IP/DNS/runtime data results to the exact software/radio state.

rules: Do not infer APN/DNN or data-session equivalence across baseband/carrier-settings changes.
If only OS version matches, comparison quality is same_os_only.
